name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2133: The board prose tooltip shipped on a flat eleven pixel token while the console twin sits on a clamp with a thirteen pixel floor, and the board is loaded inside the console through the engine iframe, so opening the shell put the same sentence on one screen in two sizes. That is the complaint the whole tooltip arc exists to answer, reintroduced by the fix for it. No gate could see it because the console type floor is console only by construction and the visual lock never checked size on either surface, so both were honest and blind at once. Both surfaces now declare a hint floor and the lock enforces it.
